team-meeting-summary-ai.0: Team meeting summary AI has gone from novelty to default in two years, and most US teams now receive some kind of automatic recap once a call wraps up. So the real question has shifted. Not whether AI can summarize a meeting, but which summary your colleagues will actually read and act on.
team-meeting-summary-ai.1: Below: the 3 built-in summarizers in Teams, Zoom and Google Meet. Then 5 cross-platform tools, plus the setup steps people search for most.
team-meeting-summary-ai.2: Yes. AI can summarize a meeting accurately enough to replace manual notes for most internal calls, typically within a few minutes of the call ending. Quality slips, though. Crosstalk, poor microphones, heavy jargon and mixed languages all drag accuracy down.
team-meeting-summary-ai.4: Before anything leaves the team, check names, numbers and dates. AI trips on those details most often.
team-meeting-summary-ai.5: Here are 8 team meeting summary AI options, 3 baked into the platforms themselves and 5 that span all of them.
team-meeting-summary-ai.6: To get an AI summary from a Teams meeting, you need two things: a Microsoft 365 Copilot license and a meeting that was recorded or transcribed. Afterward, open the meeting chat or the Recap view. Select the AI notes or summary.
team-meeting-summary-ai.7: Microsoft's announcement of its newer Recap app is explicit: intelligent summaries, audio recap and video recap all require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Unlicensed? You can still open recordings and transcripts, depending on your permissions ([Microsoft Teams recap documentation](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/teams/meetings/recap-in-microsoft-teams)).
team-meeting-summary-ai.8: No Copilot licenses at your company? Then the practical route is a third-party summarizer that joins Teams calls, and our roundup of [Teams AI note takers](https://lynkk.ai/blog/ai-note-taker-microsoft-teams) lists options.
team-meeting-summary-ai.9: Not from Microsoft. Teams' own AI summary needs a Copilot license. Free alternatives that join Teams meetings include Fathom (unlimited recordings), Otter (300 minutes a month, 30 minutes per call), Read AI (5 meetings a month) and Lynkk (5 notes a month, up to 2 hours each).
team-meeting-summary-ai.10: Where these free tiers really differ is meeting length. A 1-hour weekly team meeting fits comfortably inside Fathom, Read AI and Lynkk's free plans, while Otter's free plan cuts it off at 30 minutes. Halfway through.
team-meeting-summary-ai.11: AI Companion. That's the source of Zoom's AI summary. Once the host switches on "Meeting summary with AI Companion" mid-call, Zoom generates a recap afterward, emails it to the host and stores it in the host's Zoom account.
team-meeting-summary-ai.13: For cross-platform picks, see our [Zoom AI Companion alternatives](https://lynkk.ai/blog/zoom-ai-companion-alternatives) guide.
team-meeting-summary-ai.14: Google Meet summarizes meetings with Gemini's "Take notes for me", which writes notes into a Google Doc saved in the organizer's Drive. Eligibility matters: you need a qualifying Google Workspace edition or Google AI plan. Language support covers 8 languages, one per meeting ([Google Meet help](https://support.google.com/meet/answer/14754931)).
team-meeting-summary-ai.15: Three switches exist: the calendar event, the greenroom before joining, or the "Take notes for me" button mid-meeting. Hindi isn't on the supported list. That matters for anyone working with India-based colleagues.
team-meeting-summary-ai.16: Hopping between Zoom, Meet and Teams, or meeting in person? A cross-platform summarizer keeps every recap in one place.
team-meeting-summary-ai.17: Online calls get summarized through a bot on Zoom, Google Meet and Teams; in-person or bot-free conversations go through Lynkk's Mac app and Chrome extension instead. Every summary carries tasks with owners and dates plus a decision log, and items go to Jira in one click. What's still open? A Meeting Brief shows that before the next session. Ask Lynkk searches every summary and cites the source. Free covers 5 notes a month; Pro is $15 a month.
team-meeting-summary-ai.19: Unlimited calls, recorded and summarized, for free: that's Fathom's pitch. Team plans start at $15 per user billed yearly, with a 2-user minimum ([Fathom pricing](https://www.fathom.ai/pricing)).
team-meeting-summary-ai.20: Fireflies summarizes calls, then pushes notes into CRMs. Pro: $10 per seat, billed yearly.
team-meeting-summary-ai.21: Otter displays a live transcript as people talk, then writes a summary afterward. Pro runs $8.33 billed yearly.
team-meeting-summary-ai.22: Read AI layers engagement and talk-time metrics on top. Pro costs $15 billed yearly. See how it stacks up in [Read AI vs Otter AI](https://lynkk.ai/blog/read-ai-vs-otter-ai).
team-meeting-summary-ai.23: Pick built-in team meeting summary AI if 90% or more of your meetings happen in one platform and you already pay for its AI license. Otherwise? Go separate, especially when colleagues mix Zoom, Meet and Teams, meet face to face, or need summaries turned into Jira tasks.
team-meeting-summary-ai.24: Not ready for AI? A manual team meeting summary takes about 10 minutes. Write it within an hour, while details are still fresh, and follow the 4-part structure: decisions, action items with owners, key points, open questions.
team-meeting-summary-ai.25: Grab a copy-ready format from our [meeting summary template](https://lynkk.ai/blog/meeting-summary-template); the [follow-up email examples](https://lynkk.ai/blog/follow-up-email-after-meeting) show how to send it.
team-meeting-summary-ai.26: Yes. Microsoft Teams can summarize meetings with Copilot, which requires a Microsoft 365 Copilot license. Without one, third-party tools such as Lynkk, Fathom, Fireflies, Otter and Read AI also handle Teams calls. One habit worth keeping: verify owners and dates before any summary reaches the wider team.
team-meeting-summary-ai.27: Yes. Fathom summarizes unlimited calls for free. Otter, Read AI and Lynkk offer free tiers too, each with a monthly ceiling. Fathom has no cap at all; Otter allows 300 minutes at 30 minutes per call, Read AI 5 meetings, and Lynkk 5 notes of up to 2 hours.
team-meeting-summary-ai.28: In your inbox and your Zoom account, if you're the host. Once AI Companion's meeting summary is on, Zoom emails the recap after the call and keeps a copy in the host's account. Sharing with participants is up to the host. AI Companion comes with paid Zoom Workplace plans and covers Zoom meetings only.
team-meeting-summary-ai.29: Google Meet can summarize meetings with Take notes for me if your Workspace edition or Google AI plan includes it. It isn't fully automatic. Someone must turn it on for each meeting, or the organizer can enable it from the calendar event, and the notes land in the organizer's Google Drive.
team-meeting-summary-ai.30: Usually a few minutes. Most AI summarizers deliver a recap shortly after the meeting ends, though longer sessions and video recordings can take a little more time to process. Before sharing, review names, numbers and owners, the details AI summaries get wrong most often.
team-meeting-summary-ai.31: Some tools can. Lynkk supports Hindi, plus a Hinglish setting for speakers who mix Hindi and English. Google Meet's Take notes for me leaves Hindi off its 8 languages. Best test: a real meeting in your team's actual language mix, watching how names and numbers come through.
